text_block_list.text: On the way back from an outing with T.M. Opera O—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Oh... And you are?

text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas
text_block_list.text: Ah, um... um...

text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas
text_block_list.text:
I-I wanted to meet Opera O,
but, um, um... *sniff*... waaaah!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, please don't cry.
Your pearlescent tears are beautiful, but
a smile definitely suits you best.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hmm... From the looks of it, are they lost?

text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas
text_block_list.text:
Hic, *sob*... O-Opera...
Um, Opera O...! *Sniffle*...!

...I want to help somehow,
but first I need to calm the girl down—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: "It would be an honor, Princess! If your hands are free!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Would you allow me, the "Supreme Ruler,"
to escort you?

When T.M. Opera O extended her hand,
the little girl stopped crying
and hesitantly placed her hand on top.
...T.M. Opera O and I decided to take them to the police box first. As we were heading there—

text_block_list.name: Female Nurse
text_block_list.text:
F-Found you...!
Excuse me, that little one...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Oh... You're a nurse, aren't you?
Do you know this child?"

text_block_list.name: Female Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes... She's an inpatient at our hospital...
Wait, TM Opera O?!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Oho, it seems my name is widely known after all!

text_block_list.name: Female Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Yes, this child is a fan, you see...
It seems when she learned Tracen Academy was close by,
she snuck out.

text_block_list.name: Female Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Disappearing without saying a word is not okay, you know?
Everyone was terribly worried.

text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I-I'm... umm...
I-I'm so sorry... *sniff*

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, please forgive me just this once...!
After all, this too is because of my own beauty!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
As an apology, I'll give them my bromides... No,
I'll gift 10 copies of my "Opera Video Collection: 24 Hours With You"
to each member of the hospital staff!

text_block_list.name: Female Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no... That is, well...
...Anyway, thank you so much for taking care of it!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Phew, to think you wanted to see me so badly
you'd sneak out of the hospital...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: What sinful beauty...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, the sheer joy of meeting me... and surely,
those tears were shed over memories of a lonely journey."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: "To a child of that age, even passing cars and billboards must have looked like giant monsters."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Yet with the sole purpose of meeting me,
she overcame all her fears and made it here.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Relief at the accomplishment, joy, and pain...
In a way, those tears could be called proof of courage.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, how admirable...!
I must wholeheartedly
reciprocate her feelings...!"
...TM Opera O understood the emotions held within those tears.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: However! Sneaking out of the hospital is far too dangerous, after all!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: For now, I'd like to curb her impulses and give her something comforting, but...
choice_data_list: I wonder if it's T.M. Opera O's big moment.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, that's the best way.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Then let's get right to practice!
Trainer-kun!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The greatest opera, starring none other than myself!
Let's compose a two-hour short that fits within visiting hours!

—Let's show the girl your brilliance on the track, not in an opera...
That was how T.M. Opera O was persuaded.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: That's a great idea!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let us begin at once!
Get ready, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I'm preparing for a photo shoot!
For a photo book of myself to give to her...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Twilight me, night me... and then,
when morning comes, sunrise me!!

...And after that, I ended up spending
the rest of the day just accompanying
TM Opera O for her photoshoot...
